title: Products never sold in January
statementMd:
List products that do not appear in any order placed in January 2024.

Expected columns: `name`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Subquery on orders in January, `NOT IN`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name FROM products WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT oi.product_id FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_date LIKE '2024-01-%');
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
